manifest.notes: Bicycle (KS + understeer + first-order lag) with per-platform calibration and platform-gated per-segment delta0. Tesla passthrough (no truth channel).

_meta.notes: Lightning coeffs hand-set from anti-patterns.md priors. Mach-E K_us tuned via grid sweep from 0.002 -> 0.0015 (CTE 101 -> 99). Hyundai coeffs fitted via fit-model on 60 train / 20 dev segments, yaw_plus_cte objective. Per-segment delta0 detector uses V0 yaw-rate prediction (allowed contract column) instead of a_lat_meas_mps2 (NOT in allowlist).
